lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 장래에 무슨 일을 하고 싶어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, what do you want to do in the future?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, jangnaee museun ireul hago sipeoyo?
lines.learner: 저는 미용사가 되고 싶은데, 아직 고민 중이에요.
lines.en: I want to be a hairdresser, but I'm still thinking about it.
lines.roman: jeoneun miyongsaga doego sipeunde, ajik gomin jungieyo.

lines.beaver_en: A hairdresser? Cool. Why a hairdresser?
lines.learner: 친구 머리를 잘라 주는데, 정말 재미있어요.
lines.en: I cut my friends' hair, and it's really fun.
lines.roman: chingu meorireul jalla juneunde, jeongmal jaemiisseoyo.

lines.en: My dad is a businessperson, so he tells me to run a business.

lines.beaver_en: Still, you should do what you want.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 쉽지 않은데, 한번 도전해 볼게요.
lines.en: Right. It's not easy, but I'll give it a try.
lines.roman: majayo. swipji aneunde, hanbeon dojeonhae bolgeyo.

lines.learner: 미용실에서 직원 모집을 하는데, 지원하려고 해요.
lines.en: A hair salon is hiring staff, so I'm going to apply.
lines.roman: miyongsireseo jigwon mojibeul haneunde, jiwonharyeogo haeyo.

lines.learner: 이번 주 금요일까지인데, 서류를 준비하고 있어요.
lines.en: It's until this Friday, so I'm preparing my papers.
lines.roman: ibeon ju geumyoilkkajiinde, seoryureul junbihago isseoyo.

lines.learner: 밤늦게 끝나는 날이 많은데, 그래도 괜찮아요.
lines.en: It often ends late at night, but it's still okay.
lines.roman: bamneutge kkeunnaneun nari maneunde, geuraedo gwaenchanayo.

lines.en: Work is busy, but I'll study hard on weekends.

lines.beaver_en: What's your dream for later on?
lines.learner: 나중에는 미용실을 하는 사업가가 되고 싶어요.
lines.en: Later, I want to be a businessperson who runs a salon.
lines.roman: najungeneun miyongsireul haneun saeopgaga doego sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What a great dream. Good luck with your application!
lines.en: Thanks. I'll let you know when I get the results.
